programme.title: Wycliffe Gordon
programme.sub-title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning'. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms. Marsalis's Septet was made up of Wess Anderson (alto saxophone), Wycliffe Gordon (trombone), Reginald Veal (bass), Herlin Riley (drums), Todd Williams (tenor saxophone), and Eric Reed (piano).

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Franco Ambrosetti, George Gruntz, Steve Coleman & J.F. Clark
programme.sub-title: Franco Ambrosetti Quintet live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The composer, trumpeter and bugle player Franco Ambrosetti performs with his quintet in his native Lugano as part of the Estival.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Muddy Waters, Horace Silver & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: H. Silver, M. Waters, D. Gillespie - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In 1968, the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam welcomed three talented Americans: pianist Horace Silver, guitarist Muddy Waters, and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie, alongside their bands.

programme.title: Lalah Hathaway
programme.desc: Winner of five Grammys in four consecutive years, including the Grammy for best R&B album in 2017, Lalah Hathaway is a force impossible to ignore. The American artist has shared the scene with Prince, Snoop Dogg, Stevie Wonder, Anita Baker, Mary J. Blige, Frank Ocean and many others, an irrefutable proof of her keen musical sense and enormous talent. With a 26-year career, Hathaway is still highly sought after by the biggest names in music. See her transform the 2018 Sing Jazz festival scene into a real R&B club, where she flaunts her voice and stage presence out of the ordinary.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella
programme.sub-title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: Philip Catherine, Jean-Louis Rassinfosse & Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital's central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano's “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include “Down” and “How Deep is the Ocean”.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini' in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me'. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me'. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae' especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky
programme.sub-title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight', followed by Alexander Glazunov's Piano Sonata No. 2 in E minor, Op. 75. Then Lugansky performs a selection of works by Rachmaninoff: Rachmaninoff's piano transcription of J. S. Bach's Partita No. 3 in E major a selection of Études-Tableaux (Nos. 1, 2, 4, and 8, Op, 33, and Nos. 5 and 6, Op. 39) Lilac (Op. 21, No. 5) Prelude in C minor, Op. 23 No. 7 and Rachmaninoff's transcription of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Lullaby (Op. 16 No. 1). This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Andrea Bacchetti
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In the current recital, Bacchetti performs J. S. Bach's celebrated Goldberg Variations, BWV 988. Completed in 1741, the work is named after German harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg, who might have been the first to have performed the work. Bach's masterpiece consists of an aria and a set of thirty variations. Rather than writing variations on the aria's melody, Bach used the accompanying bass line as his starting point. This performance was recorded at Theater Carlo Felice in Genoa, Italy, on April 13, 2015.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.sub-title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The composer wrote the symphony between 1877 and 1878, and dedicated it to Nadezhda von Meck – an exceptionally wealthy widow and great admirer of Tchaikovsky's music, whom the composer described as ‘my best friend'. Tchaikovsky explained in his letters that the symphony is characterization of the nature of fate. The work opens with a powerful motif in the horns and bassoons representing fate. The second movement expresses melancholy, whereas the third presents ‘fleeting images that pass through the imagination when one has begun to drink a little wine'. Although the ‘fate' motif reappears toward the end of the final movement, the movement has a festive character. This performance was recorded at La Cité de la musique in Paris in 2016.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed his Symphony No. 5 between 1804 and 1808, completing the work around the same time as his Symphony No. 6, ‘Pastorale'. Both symphonies saw their premieres in a legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 5 has become one of the best-known compositions in western classical music. It opens with the famous four-note motif, often interpreted as the musical manifestation of 'fate knocking at the door'. This rhythmic figure returns in various guises in the other three movements of the symphony. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería & Carlos Miguel Prieto
programme.desc: The Youth Wunderhorn songs are a set of 12 orchestral lieder by Mahler, based on folk poems from the collection by Arnim and Brentano, blending romanticism with folk elements and exploring human experience with authenticity and profound emotional depth. The songs draw from German folk traditions, incorporating themes of nature, love, and soldier life, often with a dramatic or poignant quality.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvořák's spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). These 16 folk dances earned Dvořák, who was a relative newcomer when he wrote them, great success. Originally composed for piano four hands, the London Symphony Orchestra plays the orchestral version of these brilliant works. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Led Zeppelin
programme.desc: This is a documentary film about the build-up, making, release, and - crucially - music contained on this most revered of albums. With the aid of rare and classic performances, scarce interviews, seldom seen photographs and contributions from those involved in the making of the record - plus the review and critique from a panel of Zeppelin experts - this program finally lifts the lid on what many believe to be Led Zep's very finest offering. With contributions from the album's engineer, Ron Nevison former Yardbird, Chris Dreja Swansong recording artist, Maggie Bell author of The Rough Guide to Led Zeppelin, Nigel Williamson Tight But Loose editor, Dave Lewis Classic Rock Magazine's Malcolm Dome renowned guitar tutor and author, Rikky Rooksby and Robert Plant biographer, Neil Daniels. This is the complete story behind what what Rolling Stone called "their Tommy, Beggar's Banquet and Sgt. Pepper rolled into one".

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: A sarcastic father (Bernie Mac) has plenty to say about his daughter wanting to marry a white boy (Ashton Kutcher).

programme.title: Mary and The Witch's Flower
programme.desc: Young Mary follows a mysterious cat into the nearby forest and discovers an old broomstick and the strange Fly-by-Night flower, a rare plant that blossoms once every seven years. Together, the flower and the broomstick whisk Mary above the clouds, and far away to Endor College, a school of magic...

programme.title: Unfaithful
programme.desc: A middle-aged wife and mother has an affair with a handsome younger man, but her husband murders him when he finds out about the affair, and husband and wife must reckon with what happened.

programme.title: The Great Ghost Rescue
programme.desc: Young Humphrey is a ghost with a big problem. He and his family, the Craggyfords, have been ousted from their home and left without a place to haunt. As they search for new haunting grounds they soon discover that they are not alone.

programme.title: Where Angels Fear to Tread
programme.desc: After a rich Edwardian widow impulsively marries a handsome but poor Tuscan dentist and dies in childbirth, her English in-laws try to gain custody of the baby.

programme.title: A Handful of Dust
programme.desc: The wife's affair and a death in the family hasten the demise of an upper-class English marriage.

programme.title: The Client
programme.desc: A young boy witnesses a mafia lawyer take his own life and so hires a lawyer to help him out, when the District Attorney wants to use him to bring down a mob family.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Elektra unwittingly takes part in her former teacher's test when she protects a former target and his daughter from "The Hand," a sinister crime syndicate of martial arts fighters.

programme.title: Meet Dave
programme.desc: A crew of miniature aliens operate a spaceship that has a human form

programme.title: Prime
programme.desc: A career driven professional from Manhattan is wooed by a young painter, who also happens to be the son of her psychoanalyst.

programme.title: Mary Shelley
programme.desc: The torrid true-life tale of how a passionate love affair fueled the creation of trailblazing writer Mary Shelley's Gothic masterwork, Frankenstein. Elle Fanning stars.

programme.title: Hitman's Wife's Bodyguard
programme.desc: Michael Bryce continues his friendship with assassin, Darius Kincaid, as they try to save Darius' wife Sonia.

programme.title: Catch .44
programme.desc: Three friends get caught in a standoff with a psychopath, a truck driver, a line cook, and head crime boss.

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: When the White House is taken over by terrorists, a former agent must step up and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
programme.desc: A protection agent is tasked with protecting Darius Kincaid, one of the world's most famous assassins.

programme.title: For the Love of Benji
programme.desc: Benji is on holiday with his family in Greece, but after getting separated at the airport, he finds himself on another exciting adventure, now on the run from international spies!

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane is a beautiful but troubled American girl backpacking her way through Hong Kong. When she successfully fends off three thugs trying to rob her, it draws the attention of Shu, a Wudang champion, who is impressed by her raw street fighting abilities. Shu recruits Jane and trains her to fight in the vicious, all-female, underground martial arts tournament known as The Kumite.

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Vantage Point and Ben Foster, 30 Days of Night) awaken in a hyper-sleep chamber aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft. It's pitch black, they are disoriented, and the only sound is a low rumble and creak from the belly of the ship. They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: Times are hard for plumber Sid South. Up to his neck in bills, facing eviction from his home and in debt to a violent bookie, he desperately needs to raise some funds or else Sid will be a broken man - literally, as there are two thugs ready to break every bone in his body unless he hands over the cash he owes their boss. It doesn't help that Sid never seems to get paid for any of the work he does, as his occupation lands him in a variety of risqu situations which always end in disaster. Drastic times call for drastic measures, and the browbeaten plumber seeks employment from Dodger, a shady wheeler-dealer who can put some dubious work Sid's way. But, as always, things never seem to go exactly to plan and the beguiled plumber finds himself in further strife.

programme.title: Inescapable
programme.desc: Abduction thriller directed by Ruba Nadda and starring Alexander Siddig. Former Syrian intelligence officer Adib (Siddig) now works as an IT manager for a bank in Toronto after fleeing his home country over 20 years previously.

programme.title: Casual Encounters
programme.desc: Laugh-out-loud sexy comedy with Brooklyn Decker and David Arquette. Navigating through the trials and tribulations of dating in the 21st century, a recently singleton's search for Mrs. Right leads him through some wild, crazy and hilarious experiences. But sometimes Mrs. Right is not even a click away.

programme.title: Boudica
programme.desc: This historical action is the bold, bloody story of the Celtic Queen. King Prasutagus rules over the Iceni people with his wife Boudica by his side, but when he is betrayed and killed, Boudica's kingdom is left without a male heir and the Romans seize her land. Determined to avenge her husband's death, Boudica rallies the tribes from the region and wages an epic war against the Roman Empire.

programme.title: Little Bone Lodge
programme.desc: From the producers of Fall comes a twisty thriller that will chill you to the bone. During a stormy night in the Scottish Highlands, two criminal brothers on the run seek refuge in a desolate farmhouse. But after taking the resident family captive, they find the house holds even darker secrets of its own. Colour Out Of Space star Joely Richardson (Nip/Tuck) stars as the fearsome family matriarch.

programme.title: Southern Fury
programme.desc: Take a trip to the Deep South in this gruelling crime thriller, starring Nicolas Cage, John Cusack and Adrian Grenier. When a ruthless crime boss kidnaps his mobster brother Mikey, JP must go against the odds, out-ranked and out-gunned to save his brothers life. With his brothers old detective pal Sal by his side, they now face an army of relentless war-thirsty gangsters.

programme.title: Life at These Speeds
programme.desc: After a teenager's friends are killed in an accident, he finds running allows him to remember them perfectly. Running, however, also brings him notoriety. Soon he finds himself caught between keeping the past alive and making new memories in the present.

programme.title: The Buddy Holly Story
programme.desc: Buddy Holly laid the foundations for a generation of popular music with his ground-breaking combination of country music and rhythm & blues.

programme.title: The Confirmation
programme.desc: A divorced father and his eight-year-old son, spend a rather predictable weekend together, but when a valuable toolbox gets stolen, the search for the thieves will turn into a true family bonding.

programme.title: Middle of Nowhere
programme.desc: With her husband in prison, life seems bleak for Ruby, but a chance encounter puts her back on a journey towards a future she thought was lost.

programme.title: A Christmas Break

programme.title: The Magical Christmas Shoe

programme.desc: (2017) Feel-good festive romance with Autumn Reeser. When his father leaves a large sum of money to a stranger, a suspicious man goes undercover to investigate - only to make a heartwarming discovery.

programme.title: A Blue Ridge Mountain Christmas
programme.desc: Willow returns to her hometown to help with her sister's Christmas wedding. But will her life change forever when she meets the new owner of her family's former inn? Rachael Leigh Cook stars. (2019)

programme.title: Life or Something Like It
programme.desc: The perfect world of a beautiful Seattle television reporter is shattered by the prediction of her death in seven days.

programme.desc: Sexy Manhattanite Ashley is known as the luckiest woman around, but after a chance romantic encounter with down-and-out Jake, she realizes that she's swapped her fortune for his.

programme.title: A Week in Paradise
programme.desc: A film star with a newly broken heart jets off to paradise in the Caribbean, where she finds not only herself again, but maybe even a new love.

programme.title: Bite Me
programme.desc: When Sarah, a real-life vampire, gets audited by the IRS, the last thing she expects to get out of it is a date. But James, her hopelessly romantic IRS agent, thinks she's other-worldly.

programme.title: Hannah Takes the Stairs
programme.desc: Over the course of one hot post-graduate summer in Chicago, Hannah (Greta Gerwig), now a production office intern, falls precariously in and out of love.

programme.title: Return To Me
programme.desc: A man who falls in love with the woman who received his wife's heart must decide which woman it is who holds his heart.

programme.desc: A 30-something marketing executive with a top-notch career, killer wardrobe, dream apartment and great friends fills out a profile on a dating website hoping to find Mr. Right. However, her attempts at impressing her dream guy ends in disaster.

programme.title: Wycliffe Gordon
programme.sub-title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning'. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms. Marsalis's Septet was made up of Wess Anderson (alto saxophone), Wycliffe Gordon (trombone), Reginald Veal (bass), Herlin Riley (drums), Todd Williams (tenor saxophone), and Eric Reed (piano).

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Franco Ambrosetti, George Gruntz, Steve Coleman & J.F. Clark
programme.sub-title: Franco Ambrosetti Quintet live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The composer, trumpeter and bugle player Franco Ambrosetti performs with his quintet in his native Lugano as part of the Estival.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Muddy Waters, Horace Silver & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: H. Silver, M. Waters, D. Gillespie - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In 1968, the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam welcomed three talented Americans: pianist Horace Silver, guitarist Muddy Waters, and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie, alongside their bands.

programme.title: Lalah Hathaway
programme.desc: Winner of five Grammys in four consecutive years, including the Grammy for best R&B album in 2017, Lalah Hathaway is a force impossible to ignore. The American artist has shared the scene with Prince, Snoop Dogg, Stevie Wonder, Anita Baker, Mary J. Blige, Frank Ocean and many others, an irrefutable proof of her keen musical sense and enormous talent. With a 26-year career, Hathaway is still highly sought after by the biggest names in music. See her transform the 2018 Sing Jazz festival scene into a real R&B club, where she flaunts her voice and stage presence out of the ordinary.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella
programme.sub-title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: Philip Catherine, Jean-Louis Rassinfosse & Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital's central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano's “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include “Down” and “How Deep is the Ocean”.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini' in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me'. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me'. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae' especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky
programme.sub-title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight', followed by Alexander Glazunov's Piano Sonata No. 2 in E minor, Op. 75. Then Lugansky performs a selection of works by Rachmaninoff: Rachmaninoff's piano transcription of J. S. Bach's Partita No. 3 in E major a selection of Études-Tableaux (Nos. 1, 2, 4, and 8, Op, 33, and Nos. 5 and 6, Op. 39) Lilac (Op. 21, No. 5) Prelude in C minor, Op. 23 No. 7 and Rachmaninoff's transcription of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Lullaby (Op. 16 No. 1). This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Andrea Bacchetti
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In the current recital, Bacchetti performs J. S. Bach's celebrated Goldberg Variations, BWV 988. Completed in 1741, the work is named after German harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg, who might have been the first to have performed the work. Bach's masterpiece consists of an aria and a set of thirty variations. Rather than writing variations on the aria's melody, Bach used the accompanying bass line as his starting point. This performance was recorded at Theater Carlo Felice in Genoa, Italy, on April 13, 2015.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.sub-title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The composer wrote the symphony between 1877 and 1878, and dedicated it to Nadezhda von Meck – an exceptionally wealthy widow and great admirer of Tchaikovsky's music, whom the composer described as ‘my best friend'. Tchaikovsky explained in his letters that the symphony is characterization of the nature of fate. The work opens with a powerful motif in the horns and bassoons representing fate. The second movement expresses melancholy, whereas the third presents ‘fleeting images that pass through the imagination when one has begun to drink a little wine'. Although the ‘fate' motif reappears toward the end of the final movement, the movement has a festive character. This performance was recorded at La Cité de la musique in Paris in 2016.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed his Symphony No. 5 between 1804 and 1808, completing the work around the same time as his Symphony No. 6, ‘Pastorale'. Both symphonies saw their premieres in a legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 5 has become one of the best-known compositions in western classical music. It opens with the famous four-note motif, often interpreted as the musical manifestation of 'fate knocking at the door'. This rhythmic figure returns in various guises in the other three movements of the symphony. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería & Carlos Miguel Prieto
programme.desc: The Youth Wunderhorn songs are a set of 12 orchestral lieder by Mahler, based on folk poems from the collection by Arnim and Brentano, blending romanticism with folk elements and exploring human experience with authenticity and profound emotional depth. The songs draw from German folk traditions, incorporating themes of nature, love, and soldier life, often with a dramatic or poignant quality.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvořák's spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). These 16 folk dances earned Dvořák, who was a relative newcomer when he wrote them, great success. Originally composed for piano four hands, the London Symphony Orchestra plays the orchestral version of these brilliant works. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Blondie
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Blondie performs her hits including ''Heart of Glass", "Euphoria", ''Mile High" and many more…

programme.title: Led Zeppelin
programme.desc: This is a documentary film about the build-up, making, release, and - crucially - music contained on this most revered of albums. With the aid of rare and classic performances, scarce interviews, seldom seen photographs and contributions from those involved in the making of the record - plus the review and critique from a panel of Zeppelin experts - this program finally lifts the lid on what many believe to be Led Zep's very finest offering. With contributions from the album's engineer, Ron Nevison former Yardbird, Chris Dreja Swansong recording artist, Maggie Bell author of The Rough Guide to Led Zeppelin, Nigel Williamson Tight But Loose editor, Dave Lewis Classic Rock Magazine's Malcolm Dome renowned guitar tutor and author, Rikky Rooksby and Robert Plant biographer, Neil Daniels. This is the complete story behind what what Rolling Stone called "their Tommy, Beggar's Banquet and Sgt. Pepper rolled into one".

programme.title: Kiss
programme.desc: Kiss is one of the legendary groups in Hard Rock history. They have millions of fans around the world and over 100 million records sold. KISS confirms why they have been the best on the scene for nearly four decades, in a performance that made history, impressing an audience of more than 85,000 people, in a show of more than 2 hours and packed with hits, held at the Nurburgring, Germany in 2010.

programme.title: Electric Light Orchestra
programme.desc: Captured live at London's Wembley Arena and directed by Mike Mansfield this space-age show will live forever in rock history as, quite literally, out of this world featuring a pioneering laser display, the first of its kind that set a precedent for subsequent rock shows. 'Standing in the Rain', 'Night in The Rain', 'Turn to Stone', 'Tight Rope', 'Telephone Line', 'Rock Aria', 'Wild West Hero', 'Show Down', 'Sweet Talking Woman', 'Roll Over Beethoven'.

A medida que el misterio detrás de las acciones de su esposa comienza a tomar una forma oscura y amenazante, Will está decidido a buscar la verdad, sin importar lo que cueste.

programme.title: La esposa que conoció en internet
programme.desc: Una sorpresa le espera a un hombre que se casa con una mujer aparentemente perfecta.

programme.title: Lacombe Lucien
programme.desc: Segunda Guerra Mundial. Lacombe, un joven campesino cuyo padre está prisionero en Alemania y cuya madre se acuesta con su jefe, intenta afiliarse en la Resistencia. Rechazado por el cabecilla local, ingresa por azar en la policía alemana. Con una capacidad asombrosa para amoldarse a lo que su nuevo puesto le exige, su vida cambia cuando se enamora de France, la hija de un sastre judío.

programme.title: La gran comilona
programme.desc: Un grupo de cuatro amigos hastiados de su propia existencia formado por el piloto de aviones Marcello, el magistrado Philippe, el cocinero Ugo y el productor audiovisual Michel deciden reunirse en una barroca mansión de París y dar rienda suelta a su gula hasta llegar a los límites del ser humano.

programme.title: Lisboa Story (Historias de Lisboa)
programme.desc: Un cineasta alemán (Patrick Bauchau) pide a un amigo, técnico de sonido, (Rüdiger Vogler) que se reúna con él en Lisboa. Cuando éste llega, el director ha desaparecido, dejando unas cintas con imágenes pero sin sonido. El técnico recorre incansablemente las calles de Lisboa, grabando los sonidos del casco viejo de la ciudad para completar las imágenes grabadas por su amigo.

programme.title: El vídeo de Benny
programme.desc: Benny es un chico de 14 años de buena familia. Sus padres intentan compensar la falta de cariño hacia su hijo regalándole un estupendo equipo de vídeo. Obsesionado con el uso de su nuevo juguete, graba cómo sacrifican a un cerdo con una pistola, escena que lo incita a cometer un acto salvaje.

programme.title: El intruso
programme.desc: Después de presenciar un accidente con un globo aerostático, un hombre comienza a recibir la atención obsesiva de otro testigo que cree compartir un vínculo especial con él. La situación evoluciona hacia una inquietante historia de paranoia.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 11/9
programme.desc: En este documental, Michael Moore examina el clima político y social de Estados Unidos, centrándose en los acontecimientos que llevaron a la elección de Donald Trump y en las consecuencias que tuvo para el país.

programme.title: El juego de Ender
programme.desc: Harrison Ford, Asa Butterfield, Hailee Steinfeld, Ben Kingsley, Viola Davis y Abigail Breslin protagonizan esta aventura de ciencia ficción repleta de acción basada en la novela superventas.

programme.title: La carrera
programme.desc: James Hunt y Niki Lauda, dos pilotos de Fórmula 1 extremadamente hábiles, mantienen entre sí una intensa rivalidad. Sin embargo, es su enemistad lo que les lleva al límite.

programme.title: Falling
programme.desc: John vive con su pareja e hija adoptiva hasta que su padre conservador llega a Los Ángeles.

programme.title: El Mundo Es Tuyo
programme.desc: En este episodio nos vamos de viaje alrededor del mundo.

programme.title: La obra del siglo
programme.desc: En un proyecto nuclear concebido por Cuba y la URSS, un ingeniero desilusionado sobrevive con su padre.

programme.title: Whale Rider
programme.desc: La lucha de una joven maorí por alcanzar un destino que su abuelo se niega a reconocer.

programme.title: Amazing Grace
programme.desc: En 1972, Aretha Franklin grabó el histórico concierto gospel “Amazing Grace”.

programme.title: Invisibles
programme.desc: En Nueva York, un hombre que lo ha perdido todo, incluída su casa, lucha por rehacer su vida, pasando sus días en un refugio para desamparados e intentando contactar con su hija que se ha ido distanciando de él.

programme.title: Fuera de control
programme.desc: Will Graham es un hombre con oscuro pasado, que decide cambiar su vida, pero la desaparición de su hermano le obligará a volver para investigar la verdad de lo sucedido.

programme.title: El caso Sloane
programme.desc: Maquiavélica película en clave de thriller político tenso y locuaz que recuerda a los mejores guiones de Aaron Sorkin ('El ala oeste de la casa blanca'). Una implacable y ambiciosa activista luchará contra un poderoso lobby en un intento de cambiar la legislación sobre el control y venta de armas.

programme.title: Insidious: Capítulo 3
programme.desc: En esta tercera entrega de la saga, Elise Rainier acepta a utilizar su capacidad de ponerse en contacto con los muertos a fin de ayudar a una adolescente que se ha convertido en el blanco de una peligrosa entidad sobrenatural.

programme.title: Warrior (2011)
programme.desc: Warrior cuenta la inspiradora historia de una familia separada que encuentra redención en el sitio menos esperado... un ring de artes marciales mixtas.

programme.title: Hermosas criaturas
programme.desc: Siguiendo la línea de 'Crepúsculo', 'Hermosas criaturas' es un cuento de amores contrariados que esconde un oscuro y peligroso secreto. Ethan Wate es un adolescente que sueña con escapar de su rutinaria vida en la pequeña localidad de Gatlin, hasta que conoce a Lena Duchannes.

programme.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
programme.desc: Un diseñador de coches se enfrenta a toda la industria automovilística con sus revolucionarios diseños.

programme.title: El largo camino a casa
programme.desc: En los años 50, en Montgomery, un pueblecito de Alabama, los prejuicios raciales y sociales están a la orden del día. Odessa es una mujer negra que trabaja como asistenta en la casa de Miriam Thompson, una mujer blanca de buena posición.

programme.title: Cariño, cuánto te odio
programme.desc: Rivales laborales descubren el amor.

programme.title: Me Quiere, No Me Quiere
programme.desc: Un mujeriego vuelve a casa por vacaciones y se enreda con la mujer que le rompió el corazón años atrás.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Tras su fiesta de despedida, despierta en el apartamento de un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: Lejos de la tierra quemada
programme.desc: Ópera prima de Guillermo Arriaga como director. Cuatro intensas historias en torno al amor.

programme.title: De vuelta a casa
programme.desc: Alice (Reese Witherspoon) es una mujer recién separada que decide enfrentarse a nuevos retos y vuelve a Los Ángeles para construirse una nueva vida. Un nuevo trabajo que no es exactamente lo que ella esperaba, un colegio nuevo para sus hijos y facturas que pagar.

programme.title: Por amor a Grace
programme.desc: Un apuesto bombero no ha vuelto a ser el mismo desde que murió su mujer. Sumido en una gran tristeza y apatía, acaba de ser suspendido temporalmente de su empleo por desobediencia. Esa misma noche se desata un devastador incendio en el piso de una joven a la que le salva la vida.

programme.title: Pequeño Manhattan
programme.desc: Little Manhattan es una agradable comedia perfecta tanto para niños como para adultos. En una ciudad conocida por su agitación, dos jóvenes amigos se embarcan en la mayor aventura de su vida.

programme.title: Alex y Eva
programme.desc: Alex es un atractivo maestro de escuela de unos treinta años cuyos padres quieren que se case con una buena chica griega.

programme.title: Train to Busan
programme.desc: Un brote viral misterioso pone a Corea en estado de emergencia. Seok-woo y su hija suben al KTX, el tren rápido que une los 453 km que separan Seúl de Busan. Pero justo en el momento de su partida, la estación es invadida por zombis y uno de ellos sube a bordo. Mientras el tren alcanza su máxima velocidad, los pasajeros tendrán que luchar por sus vidas.

programme.title: Tormenta del pasado
programme.desc: Tras presenciar la muerte de sus padres a causa de un tornado, April Saunders decide convertirse en una cazadora de tormentas, experta de condiciones climáticas extremas. Cuando una tormenta gigante amenaza con destruir la ciudad en la que su hermano es el Sheriff, intentará persuadirle para evacuarla antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Para ello deberá luchar contra los demonios de su pasado, así como con sus fracasadas relaciones del presente, en un intento por salvar a las personas que ama.

programme.title: El valor de una madre
programme.desc: Aline nunca ha logrado superar la muerte de su hijo de 17 años en una pelea callejera.

programme.title: Contaminación: Alien invade la Tierra
programme.desc: Un astronauta ayuda a agentes del gubernamentales y a un detective en la investigación de unas misteriosas esporas alienígenas.

programme.title: Hojas de Hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos cambian cuando el profesor de filosofía es confundido un traficante de drogas.

programme.title: Los tigres del tren
programme.desc: Un ferroviario en la China de 1941 lucha contra los japoneses para lograr comida para los pobres.

programme.title: Nowhere
programme.desc: En un país latinoamericano, su dictador ha urdido un siniestro plan.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Asuntos de familia (2009)
programme.desc: Vince Rizzo es un funcionario de prisiones que descubre en la lista de nuevos reclusos un nombre familiar. Se trata de Tony, un hijo que tuvo 20 años atrás y que abandonó al no poder hacerse cargo de él. A pesar de estar de estar casado y con una familia distinta, Vince se lleva a Tony a casa...

programme.title: Un padre de cuidado
programme.desc: Tim Allen es Joe, un chico cuya vida ha ido constantemente cambiando para peor. Cuando el acosador de la oficina va demasiado lejos, Joe decide que es hora volverse a sí mismo de un don nadie en un alguien.

programme.title: Con la magia en los zapatos
programme.desc: Max Simkin (Adam Sandler) repara zapatos en una tienda neoyorquina perteneciente a su familia. Desencantado con su rutina diaria, Max tropieza con una reliquia familiar que le permite ser testigo de la vida de sus clientes a través de los zapatos que repara y ver el mundo de una forma nueva.

programme.title: La muerte de Stalin
programme.desc: La noche del 2 de marzo de 1953 murió un hombre. Ese hombre es Josef Stalin, dictador, tirano, carnicero y Secretario General de la URSS. Y si juegas bien tus cartas, el puesto ahora puede ser tuyo.

programme.title: El Ministro y Yo
programme.desc: Cantinflas consigue un empleo de alto nivel y nos muestra los defectos de la burocracia con una gran dosis de diversión.

programme.title: ¿Cuándo Llegamos?
programme.desc: Nick , un joven operador está deseando conseguir pedirle una cita a una mujer atractiva, Suzanne, de la que está locamente enamorado. Después de esperar un largo tiempo parece que el momento más esperado para Nick está a punto de llegar. Suzanne se encuentra atrapada en Vancouver y necesita a alguien que pueda recoger a sus hijos y llevarles hasta ella, Nick se ofrece para ser esa persona sin dudarlo, pero lo que no sabe es que para ellos ningún hombre es lo suficientemente bueno para su madre. El viaje que Nick se imaginaba no tendrá nada que ver con el que les espera, ya que acabará siendo una pesadilla.

programme.title: High School High
programme.desc: Richard Clark es un profesor idealista que trabaja como maestro en una elitista escuela y decide trasladarse al instituto más conflictivo y rebelde de uno de los barrios marginales de la ciudad. Allí, su inocente personalidad y sus sorprendentes técnicas de enseñanza dejarán perplejos a todos los estudiantes y el profesorado. Clark lucha por ser comprendido y no pierde la esperanza de convertir a los alumnos gandules en genios.

programme.title: Zohan: Licencia Para Peinar
programme.desc: Zohan es un agente de élite del Mossad que guarda un secreto: su sueño es convertirse en peluquero en Estados Unidos. Aprovechando una pelea contra su peor enemigo, un terrorista conocido como ‘El Fantasma', Zohan finge su propia muerte y vuela a Nueva York, armado únicamente con sus tijeras y su secador de pelo.A pesar de su inexperiencia, pronto es contratado por el dueño de una peluquería y consigue atraer a una gran multitud de clientes. Sin embargo, el sueño de Zohan corre peligro cuando su antiguo enemigo le reconoce y planea acabar con él de una vez por todas.

programme.title: ¡Así es mi tierra!
programme.desc: En el México revolucionario, un exitoso ganadero regresa como héroe y se prepara para casarse. Pero su futura esposa ama en secreto a otro hombre, mientras un antiguo rival, amenazado por su popularidad, comienza a tramar un peligroso plan contra él.

programme.title: El potro
programme.desc: Durante el fragor de la batalla en medio de la guerra civil, un potro nace de la yegua del soldado Jim Rabb. Rechazando las órdenes de fusilarlo, Rabb se queda con el potro como consuelo en estos tiempos desesperados.

programme.title: The Warrant
programme.desc: Una orden de arresto lleva al alguacil John Breaker y al ayudante Bugle Bearclaw a cruzar el país para entregar a un criminal.

programme.title: 500 $, vivo o muerto
programme.desc: Un pie tierno se convierte en cazarrecompensas con la esperanza de labrarse un futuro mejor para él y su nuevo amor.

programme.title: Gloriosos camaradas
programme.desc: ¿Qué podría ser peor para dos oficiales de caballería que luchar contra las tribus nativas? Luchar entre sí por la misma mujer.

programme.title: The Take Down
programme.desc: The Take Down sigue a Jack, un sicario de Londres, que recibe una segunda oportunidad de salvar a su hija. En una carrera contrarreloj llena de acción, debe enfrentarse a enemigos letales, donde cada decisión es cuestión de matar o morir.

programme.title: Eva
programme.desc: Un guionista teatral toma refugio en un chalet durante una violenta nevada, donde conoce a una misteriosa mujer.

programme.title: En primera línea
programme.desc: Un equipo de bomberos del Ejército de Estados Unidos está fracturado por tensiones raciales, crisis morales y las presiones del combate en una guerra que nadie quiere pelear.

programme.title: Lidice
programme.desc: Tras una pelea en un bar, un padre borracho mata a su hijo accidentalmente. Šima es condenado por asesinato y enviado a prisión.

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos
programme.desc: A Valeria le ha cambiado la vida por completo. La separación de sus padres la ha llevado a trasladarse a Madrid con su madre. Eso supone muchas cosas nuevas. Casa, instituto, amigos…La cosa se complica todavía más cuando Valeria se ve obligada a asistir al grupo de terapia que organiza el psicólogo del instituto. Allí se encontrará con otros compañeros que también se ven obligados a ir pero lo que parece un mal comienzo paralajoven adolescente, no es más que el inicio de una increíble experiencia vital nuevos amigos, una ciudad llena de posibilidades, acariciar la madurez y sobre todo descubrir que el primer amor es bastante más complicado de lo que se dice en loscuentos de princesas.

programme.title: Zeros and Ones
programme.desc: JJ (Ethan Hawke), un soldado norteamericano destinado en Roma, ve saltar por los aires la ciudad del Vaticano a plena noche. Así se embarcará en un heroico viaje para descubrir y enfrentarse a un enemigo desconocido que está amenazando al mundo entero. Pero ¿qué papel jugará en todo esto su hermano, un radical revolucionario que se encuentra en búsqueda y captura?

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Dos amigos judíos de edad avanzada (Allen y Turturro) se encuentran ante una desesperada situación financiera. Deciden entonces probar suerte con el negocio de la prostitución masculina, uno como gigoló y el otro como "representante". Pero el asunto no será bien visto en la comunidad judía en la que viven.

programme.title: Madame
programme.desc: Anne y Bob, una pareja americana que vive en París, organizan una cena e invitan a diez amigos. El hijo de Bob llega por sorpresa y el número total de invitados es ahora de 13. La supersticiosa Anne le pide a su criada, María, que pretenda ser un rico amigo español y se unan a la mesa. María conoce a David, un aristócrata británico. Ambos se gustan y continuarán su relación.

programme.title: Animales Heridos
programme.desc: Historias que se cruzan sobre parejas, la soledad y las heridas del amor.

programme.title: Los días que vendrán
programme.desc: Vir (30) y Lluís (32) hace solo un año que salen juntos, cuando descubren que están “embarazados”. Durante 9 meses, seguiremos la aventura de esta joven pareja barcelonesa, el giro enorme que dará su vida, sus miedos, alegrías y las realidades que, durante su embarazo, crecen ante ellos.

programme.title: Tiempo después
programme.desc: Año 9177, en un futuro postapocalíptico. El mundo entero se ha visto reducido a un edificio y unas afueras. En el edificio vive el "establishment", las fuerzas vivas, y en las afueras miles y miles de parados.

programme.title: La higuera de los bastardos
programme.desc: Rogelio Cerón es un falangista encargado de fusilar a residentes en el municipio de Getxo. Su visión del mundo cambiará cuando conoce a un niño al que le ha arrebatado a sus padres, sabiendo que cuando este crezca le acabará asesinando.

programme.title: En primera línea
programme.desc: Situé au Viêt Nam en avril 1968, trois mois après l'offensive du Têt et un mois après l'assassinat de Martin Luther King Jr, Point Man raconte l'histoire d'une équipe de pompiers de l'armée américaine fracturée par les tensions raciales, les crises morales et les pressions écrasantes du combat dans une guerre que personne ne veut mener. Andre « Casper » Allen, un idéologue brutal, est en désaccord avec Silas Meeks, le mitrailleur de l'escouade, en raison de ses idées radicales. Lorsque leur mission de recherche et de destruction dans le delta du Mékong tourne mal, les deux hommes se retrouvent opposés l'un à l'autre et à leur chef de section récalcitrant, le lieutenant Sutter. Les hommes de pointe meurent comme des mouches dans la brousse, et à mesure que les loyautés se dissolvent, chaque pas en avant a un prix.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Mientras un hombre conduce su moto por el desierto, unos matones le roban el vehículo y lo dan por muerto. Sobrevive y ya no piensa en el suicidio, porque ahora tiene un objetivo en la vida: vengarse y recuperar su moto.

programme.title: Vacaciones Tragicas
programme.desc: Una familia se ve atrapada cuando la casa de vacaciones que alquilan se inunda por la lluvia y un agresivo tiburón ha conseguido entrar.

programme.title: Asalto a Wall Street
programme.desc: Jim, un neoyorquino corriente, vive con una esposa enferma pero cariñosa. De repente, todo cambia cuando la economía se hunde y lo pierde todo. Lleno de ira y rabia, Jim se propone vengarse de la vida que le han arrebatado.

programme.title: USS Seaviper

programme.title: Blind man
programme.desc: Comienza con el descubrimiento de un cadáver. Un solitario policía sospecha rápidamente de un hombre ciego, cuya minusvalía le resulta una ventaja. Empieza así una carrera contrarreloj y un duelo a muerte entre dos hombres a cuál más enigmático.

programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: Musculoso y espectacular reboot de la mítica serie de los 90' a medio camino entre 'Transformers' y el cine de superhéroes. 5 jóvenes estudiantes van a descubrir que La Tierra está al borde de la extinción por una amenaza alienígena. Pronto descubrirán que son los únicos que pueden salvar el planeta

programme.title: Código fuente
programme.desc: ¿Es posible viajar en el tiempo para evitar una catástrofe? El capitán Colter Stevens (Jake Gyllenhaal) tiene la difícil misión de conseguirlo en esta eficaz película de acción y ciencia-ficción considerada como una de las mejores películas del género de los últimos años.

programme.title: El tren de las 3:10
programme.desc: Dan Evans, un ranchero de Arizona y veterano de la Guerra de Secesión, escolta al forajido Ben Wade para ganar dinero. La tensión aumenta cuando se enfrentan a la violencia y a los cómplices de Wade. Nominada a dos Oscar en 2008.

programme.title: Escape Room (2019)
programme.desc: Una intrigante invitación reúne a seis extraños para participar en un escape room, pero pronto descubrirán que son víctimas de un sádico juego a vida o muerte. Habitación tras habitación, avanzarán por los terroríficos escenarios buscando y resolviendo las pruebas, pero sobre todo, los jugadores deberán aprender a confiar los unos en los otros y desvelar sus secretos más oscuros para sobrevivir.

programme.title: District 9
programme.desc: Del productor Peter Jackson y el director Neill Blomkamp surge un asombrosamente original thriller de ciencia ficción que en el que se envía a un grupo de refugiados alienígenas, varados en la Tierra a un barrio bajo a las afueras de Johannesburgo.

programme.title: El Libro de Eli
programme.desc: Eli (Denzel Washington), un guerrero solitario, camina en una tierra arrasada por la hecatombe una tierra que una vez fue los Estados Unidos. Se dirige hacia el Oeste para llevar a cabo una misión que no acaba de entender del todo pero que sabe que debe cumplir. Protege con su vida la última copia de un libro sagrado que puede ser la llave para salvar la humanidad. Sólo Carnegie (Gary Oldman), un autoproclamado jefe militar que gobierna una ciudad de ladrones y pistoleros, conoce el poder que Eli tiene en sus manos y ha decidido arrebatárselo. Pero nada puede interponerse en el camino de Eli. Nada puede impedirle cumplir con su destino y ayudar a un mundo arruinado.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hollywood
programme.desc: Érase una vez... en Hollywood de Quentin Tarantino, nos traslada a Los Ángeles de 1969, donde todo está cambiando, y donde la estrella de la televisión Rick Dalton (Leonardo DiCaprio), y Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt), su doble desde hace muchos años, se abren camino en una industria que ya prácticamente no reconocen. La novena película del célebre escritor y director cuenta con amplio reparto y múltiples tramas argumentales que rinden un tributo a los momentos finales de la época dorada de Hollywood.
